name: Mundane Glasses
body:
Price 2,000 gp; Slot eyes; CL 5th; Weight –; Aura faint transmutation

DESCRIPTION

A pair of small unassuming glasses that appear to make the wearer appear more ordinary. If the wearer possesses the seamless guise class feature or the Masked Identity feat, the circumstance bonus from that ability increases by 5. The wearer also gains a +5 circumstance bonus to disguise checks made while using a vigilante talent while in their social identity to keep their identity a secret.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells disguise self
